name: Differentiable Neural Radiosity
definition: A method representing the differential radiance field (derivative of radiance w.r.t. scene parameters) using a neural network, trained by minimizing the residual of the differential rendering equation.
summary: Differentiable Neural Radiosity is a method that uses a neural network to represent the gradient of the radiance field, enabling gradient-based inverse rendering with constant time and memory complexity relative to path length.
